_provenance: unverified: Network File Storage (NFS) shapes as DigitalOcean's API reference describes them (resources nfs: share {id, name, size_gib, region (a slug), status CREATING/ACTIVE/FAILED/DELETED, created_at, vpc_ids, host, mount_path}; snapshot {id, name, size_gib, region, status UNKNOWN/CREATING/ACTIVE/FAILED/DELETED, created_at, share_id}; action {status, type, started_at, completed_at, resource_id, resource_type, region_slug}). No spec clone was available offline when the provider was written (lane do-nfs, 2026-11-05): field names, the required ?region= query, the 50 GiB minimum and the absence of tags on shares stay unverified until the opt-in live suite records them. Values are illustrative; the emulator spreads these templates and overrides ids, names, regions, sizes, VPCs and statuses.
